randomness.rule: Use bounded seeded randomness for weather, accidents, discovery and demographic noise. Never use randomness to force a dramatic story.

countryDecision.description: Policy candidates are resolved by persistent citizen institutions; no fixed country objective function is used.

resolution.rule: Policy agent chooses actions; resolution engine calculates consequences. The same agent must not freely choose both action and successful outcome.

firstContactRequires: geographic reach overlap OR signal detection
afterContact: small conserved material exchange once a sustained route exists

publication.publishOnlyIf: turn contains a contested or institutionally important decision, demographic consequence, major material-state change, exploration discovery or first contact
publication.spoilers: Country-perspective articles never reveal information unavailable to that country.

safety.fictionDisclosure: Clearly state that countries, citizens and statistics are fictional simulations.
safety.realPolitics: Do not map countries onto current real-world parties, ethnicities or nations.
safety.casualtyHandling: Avoid gratuitous suffering; summarize crises without exploitative detail.

checks: exact seven-day calendar continuity and year rollover
all four seasons and seasonal food/fuel movement
pregnancy, birth, death, birthday and life-stage transitions
crossover knowledge consistency if contact occurs
bounded live-history windows with immutable per-turn archives
zero food/fuel reserves remain valid crisis states and must produce modeled consequences rather than engine failure

time.realTimeRule: After public rebuild completion, each full seven elapsed real-world days makes exactly one additional seven-day world turn due.
time.catchUp: Scheduled poll every 6 hours; resolve at most four missing contiguous turns per run. Never skip or overwrite a turn.

demography.rule: Conception creates persistent pregnancy state; birth can occur only in its due interval. Birthdays derive from bornAbsoluteDay.
demography.partnerships: Eligible unpartnered adults can form persistent partnerships; household moves are recorded and close-family matches are prohibited.

materialDynamics.food: Seasonal production + weather + renewable-resource stock effects + reserve-dependent spoilage. Low reserves trigger rationing; sustained scarcity raises stress, lowers health and fertility, and raises mortality without halting the engine at zero reserves.
materialDynamics.fuel: Seasonal production/consumption + weather + resource stock effects + pre-winter preparation + adaptive scarcity collection + conservation. Extra collection costs food-production opportunity and ecological stock; low winter fuel affects health/stress.
materialDynamics.resources: Renewables regenerate as a function of remaining capacity; occupation output falls when relevant resource stocks decline.
materialDynamics.politicalLearning: Citizen policy experience and evolving trust/respect/grievance affect future votes and institutional selection.
